description: Maps each app's Steam genre list onto one of FORMULATION.md section 2's three Boxleiter multiplier buckets, using a primary-genre selection rule since a title may report multiple genres.
signature: def map_genre_bucket(genres: pd.Series, params: EnrichmentParams) -> pd.Series
docstring:
Map genre lists to multiplier buckets.

Args:
    genres: A pd.Series of genre lists (already json.loads'd from genres_json), one list per appid, in the order Steam's appdetails API reports them (Steam's first-listed genre is generally its primary/marketing genre).
    params: EnrichmentParams.genre_bucket_map, mapping an individual genre string to a bucket key.

Returns:
    A pd.Series of bucket key strings ('niche' | 'mainstream' | 'broad_audience'), one per appid. Bucket selection rule: use the FIRST genre in the row's list that has an entry in genre_bucket_map (in list order, i.e. respecting Steam's primary-genre-first convention); if none of the row's genres match any key in genre_bucket_map, or the genre list is empty, fall back to 'mainstream' (the documented default bucket, per FORMULATION.md section 2's explicit inclusion of 'unmatched/default' in that bucket's genre list).
preconditions: Every value in genres is a list[str] (possibly empty), never None (normalize_features guarantees genres_json defaults to '[]')
postconditions: Every returned value is one of the three bucket keys present in params.boxleiter_multipliers
An unmatched or empty genre list always maps to 'mainstream', never raises

edge_cases.input: genres = ['Some Obscure Genre Not In The Map']
genres = ['Action', 'Strategy'] where 'Action' maps to broad_audience and 'Strategy' maps to niche
edge_cases.expected_behavior: 'broad_audience' -- the FIRST matching genre in list order wins, per Steam's primary-genre-first convention, not an alphabetical or highest-multiplier tiebreak
'mainstream', per FORMULATION.md section 2's explicit note that Horror and RPG are deliberately mapped there as a neutral default

unit_tests.name: test_first_matching_genre_wins
unit_tests.description: ['Action','Strategy'] with Action->broad, Strategy->niche resolves to broad_audience.

unit_tests.name: test_unmatched_genre_falls_back_to_default
unit_tests.description: A genre absent from genre_bucket_map falls back to mainstream.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_genre_list_falls_back_to_default
unit_tests.description: An empty genre list falls back to mainstream.

unit_tests.name: test_horror_and_rpg_map_to_mainstream
unit_tests.description: ['Horror'] and ['RPG'] both resolve to mainstream per FORMULATION.md.
